scheme_name: Mandahasam Scheme To Provide Artificial Dentures To Senior Citizens
other_conditions: Applicant must have completely lost teeth or partially lost teeth that are unusable and require extraction
Applicant must be certified by a qualified dentist in the prescribed form as unfit for placing artificial teeth
Priority will be given to the oldest applicant
benefits_summary: Maximum financial assistance of ₹5,000 per beneficiary for fixing the tooth.
